milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close to the orange tulip (placed at spawn-relative [8, 0, 8]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it among the scattered flowers. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the tulip.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted light_gray_bed ends up in the player's inventory after crafting. The player retrieves materials (3 white_wool, 3 oak_planks, 1 light_gray_dye) from the nearby chest, crafts a white bed first, then combines it with light_gray_dye to produce the light_gray_bed. This is the most reliable check for craft completion.
